findings.reason: the plan should cite and reuse (or extract) the existing resolver instead of adding a third copy in parallel.py.
findings.text: §19 plans to resolve a code chunk's source path by reading `src.source_file` (the CodeExample) and falling back to the chunk's own `source_file`, but that exact resolution already exists as `coalesce(ce.source_file, cc.source_file) AS source_file` in imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:483 and imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1659; the plan searched the HAS_CHUNK *writer* (correctly, and heads off a duplicate relink pass) but did not search for the *resolver*, so it would re-derive working logic

findings.reason: §19 must name the mechanism it extends (or extract one resolver into a shared owner) so the code-chunk source path has a single owner rather than three parallel expressions.
findings.text: the §19 fallback (`src.source_file` else the chunk's `source_file`) duplicates the shared CodeChunk→source_file resolution already owned by `_enrich_code_chunks` at imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1659 and `find_code` at imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:483, so a third divergent copy would drift from them

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the two open sections add no new module; §19 changes an attribute read inside the existing code-context query in imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:203 and repairs the existing single edge writer, and §14 drives the existing `discover paths --root` and `discover code --path-prefix` entry points.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §19 would add a third hand-rolled copy of the CodeChunk→source_file resolution whose two existing owners are imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1659 (`_enrich_code_chunks`) and imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:483 (`find_code`).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §19 states "Interface budget: nothing added" and §14 reuses the existing `--root`/`--path-prefix` options without a new CLI option, MCP view, public definition or refusal family.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §19's proposed code-chunk source-path resolution (`src.source_file` falling back to the chunk's own `source_file`) re-derives logic that already exists as `coalesce(ce.source_file, cc.source_file)` in imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:483 and imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1659, and the plan cites neither.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §19 adds no wrapper: it edits the existing lookup and reuses `ingest_files` (imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py:522, reached from imas_codex/discovery/code/workers.py:734) as the sole HAS_CHUNK writer rather than adding a relink pass; §14 adds no layer over the paths pipeline.
